title: RayQuery feature/extension reconciliation and explicit support logs
purpose: Guarantee VK_KHR_ray_query is enabled correctly and print authoritative support logs; persist flags for later CRs.

steps.detail: In VulkanContext::createLogicalDevice, ensure VkPhysicalDeviceRayQueryFeaturesKHR{rayQuery=VK_TRUE} is chained through to vkCreateDevice along with VkPhysicalDeviceAccelerationStructureFeaturesKHR and bufferDeviceAddress. Do not drop structs by overwriting pNext.
Set and store m_supportsRayQuery and m_supportsAccelerationStructure based on extension presence and enabled features.
After device creation, print once per run: 'Ray Query extension enabled: <YES/NO>', 'Ray Query feature (rayQuery) enabled: <YES/NO>', 'Acceleration Structure extension enabled: <YES/NO>'.

acceptance: logs/run.txt contains the three support lines once per run
Application runs without new validation errors
m_supportsRayQuery and m_supportsAccelerationStructure reflect actual enablement
notes: Ensure pNext chain continuity: atomicFloat -> accelerationStructure -> rayQuery -> meshShader? -> vk12Features -> vk13 -> vk14 (or equivalent ordering used).
